terminalMode.label: Default terminal mode
terminalMode.hint: What a new tab starts on — the start screen offers it per launch, and the status bar switches a tab already running. Clicks lets Claude Code's own prompts, subagents and shells take the mouse; Scrollback keeps the terminal's own history, which is what the scrollbar, the find bar, the path beside the scrollbar and the width repair need. No session can have both.

defaultDirectory.label: Default directory
defaultDirectory.hint: Blank uses the last directory you opened

runIn.label: Run in
runIn.hint: Where a new tab's session starts

fontFamily.label: Font family
fontFamily.counted: {{fixed}} of {{total}} installed families can hold a terminal grid
fontFamily.unreadable: The installed families could not be read, so this is the built-in list — most of what you have is missing from it

allSystemFonts.label: Show all system fonts
allSystemFonts.hint: Off, the list holds the fixed-pitch families only — which is almost never the whole of what is installed

shellIntegration.label: Shell integration
shellIntegration.hint: Lets a zsh or bash tab offer a copy control per command and complete what you type from its history — the shell an agent tab hands back to included. Applies to tabs started after the change.

image.label: Image
image.hint: Drawn behind the terminal in every tab

preview.unreadable: That file could not be read as an image.
preview.label: Background preview

editor.label: Open in
editor.none: No editor command found on your PATH
editor.hint: Used by the button in each tab's status bar

notifyOnDone.label: When a session is done
notifyOnDone.hint: When a session finishes a turn, hands back to the shell, or ends
notifyOnDone.control: Notify when a session is done

notifyOnlyWhenUnfocused.label: Only when looking elsewhere
notifyOnlyWhenUnfocused.hint: Stay quiet while that tab is already on screen

pullRequests.label: Pull request in the footer
pullRequests.hint: Shows the branch's pull request and its checks, asked of your own GitHub CLI (gh) once a minute while the tab is on screen. Needs gh installed and signed in.

editCards.label: Edit cards over the terminal
editCards.hint: A card for each file that changes in the tab's working tree — usually the agent's edits: its name, how many lines, and the lines themselves. Click one to open its diff.

editActivity.label: Activity in the review drawer
editActivity.hint: A timeline of the edits in this tab's working tree, newest first.

editPulse.label: Flash edited files
editPulse.hint: A file's row flashes in Changes and Files as it is edited.

journal.label: Record what sessions print
journal.hint: Kept verbatim, so earlier sessions in a folder can be listed and reopened

errorLog.label: Error log
errorLog.hint: Errors, crashes and freezes, for when something goes wrong. Never what a session prints

reset.label: Everything else
reset.hint: Restores every setting on this page
